tos_intro_1: Welcome to TaskPi! These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the TaskPi platform ("the Platform"), a decentralized microtask marketplace powered by the Pi Network.
tos_intro_2: By accessing or using TaskPi, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.

whitepaper_subtitle: A Decentralized Microtask Ecosystem on the Pi Network
abstract_text: TaskPi introduces a decentralized, trust-driven platform where users complete simple tasks in exchange for Pi coins. With a tiered user system, human validators, and reputation-based access, TaskPi ensures fair participation and scalable validation.
problem_underpay: Centralized microtask platforms often underpay and rely heavily on automation.
problem_validation_issues: Validation is either poor or costly.
solution_transparency: Transparent task lifecycle with proof submission and peer review
level_3_desc: Trusted validators earn small rewards per review
anti_fraud_crosscheck: Cross-checking and banning of bad actors
phase_4_desc: Integrate AI personalization engine to analyze user behavior and optimize task recommendations
conclusion_text: With planned AI integration, TaskPi will ensure users receive tasks aligned with their behavior and interests. TaskPi empowers real users, enables trust at scale, and utilizes the Pi Network’s unique community to create an economy of micro-effort and mutual benefit.
